correctness.rationale: Six-block exact product dissection F(X)=P(X)(1-X^64)^-30 F(X^64) expresses each residue section as P_r(Y)/[(1-Y)^30 T(Y)^5]; independently reconstructed degree-1605 P with all four target sections identical modulo 32. A mod-8 polynomial Q satisfying Q(Y)(1+Y^32)=(1-Y)^6 Q(Y²) and finite H identity proves T(Y)^6=Q(Y)/(1-Y^32) mod8 by uniqueness of constant-one formal Mahler solutions. The independent checker verified Q and H polynomial congruences, and P_*=16(1-Y)^24+12H mod32. Unit-denominator division then establishes 16/(1-Y)+12T(Y) mod32 at all k. Legendre three-squares excludes 28 mod32 (4*(8m+7)), and permits 4 mod32; adjacent Thue–Morse cancellation yields density 1/2 per progression, four of 64 giving 1/32. Independent coefficient recurrence checked initial 4096 terms only as auxiliary. Entire exceptional set density remains unknown.
